workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Python SDK files.read of files over ~500 KB fails at random with too_many_data_frames (pyqwest h2)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(python-sdk): download files over HTTP/1.1 to avoid h2 too_many_data_frames. Target files: packages/python-sdk/e2b/api/client_async/__init__.py, packages/python-sdk/e2b/api/client_sync/__init__.py, packages/python-sdk/e2b/connection_config.py. . Same change as the closed #2039, rebased on `main`. It replaces the `Accept-Encoding: identity` approach from #2087, which broke `/proc` and `/sys` reads on envd 0.10.0. (Ref: https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B/pull/2088)

workarounds.symptom: JS Code Interpreter OutputMessage.timestamp uses client clock, ignores backend timestamp
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(code-interpreter): use backend timestamp in JS OutputMessage. Target files: packages/code-interpreter-js/src/messaging.ts, packages/code-interpreter-js/tests/messaging.test.ts, .changeset/js-output-backend-timestamp.md. The JS Code Interpreter's `parseOutput` set `OutputMessage.timestamp` to `new Date().getTime() * 1000` — the **client-side clock in microseconds** — ignoring the `timestamp` field the kernel sends with every stdout/stderr message. (Ref: https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B/pull/1970)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: JS SDK: filesystem watch handle.stop() always fires onExit with a TimeoutError blaming 'requestTimeoutMs'
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(js-sdk): treat WatchHandle.stop() as a clean watch end. Target files: packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/filesystem/index.ts, packages/js-sdk/src/sandbox/filesystem/watchHandle.ts, packages/js-sdk/tests/sandbox/files/watchHandle.test.ts. `WatchHandle.stop()` is the documented way to end a directory watch, but every user-initiated stop fired `onExit` with a `TimeoutError` blaming `requestTimeoutMs`: `stop()` aborts the stream, the abort surfaces as a Connect cancellation, and the error mapping treats it as a request timeout. (Ref: https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B/pull/1912)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: Template copy() includes files that .dockerignore / fileIgnorePatterns should exclude (JS + Python)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(sdk): apply .dockerignore patterns Docker-style when copying template files. Target files: packages/js-sdk/src/template/dockerignore.ts, packages/js-sdk/src/template/index.ts, packages/js-sdk/src/template/types.ts. . Template `copy()` didn't apply `.dockerignore` / `fileIgnorePatterns` the way Docker does. Ignored files (`.env`, `node_modules`, `.git`, ...) were still uploaded and still counted toward the files hash. Both SDKs now use Docker's matching rules: patterns are relative to the context root, and the last matching p... (Ref: https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B/pull/1917)

workarounds.symptom: [Bug]: e2b 2.35.1 ESM bundle crashes in Cloudflare Workers at createRequire(import.meta.url)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(js-sdk): drop bare require calls that crash edge runtimes at import. Target files: packages/js-sdk/src/template/utils.ts, packages/js-sdk/src/utils.ts, packages/js-sdk/tests/bundle/edgeCompat.test.ts. . Bare `require` references in the SDK's ESM source made tsdown emit an eager `createRequire(import.meta.url)` shim at module scope in `dist/index.mjs`, which throws in Cloudflare Workers (workerd) where `import.meta.url` is undefined in bundled code — so `import 'e2b'` crashed before any API call. (Ref: https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B/pull/1583)
